plan.title: Reject surrogate bid with rebid allowed

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Open the RFQ Responses view where the vendor bid and Reject control are shown.
Open the rejection confirmation dialog for Vendor A's bid.
Verify that the rejection dialog opened.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Verify the dialog identifies Vendor A's bid for rejection.
Confirm rejection after entering the reason and enabling rebid.
Verify the rejection remark is displayed after confirmation.
Verify the bid is visibly marked rejected.
Open the stage's Rejected Bids view.

steps.note: Verify the rejected-bids record contains the exact rejection remark.

Open the event overview in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor portal shows the bid as rejected.
Verify the vendor can see the rejection reason.
